question: Which was the first commercial and marketing arm of ISRO?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Antrix Corporation Limited**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Antrix Corporation Limited (ACL) is the commercial and marketing arm of the Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO): 
 
• ACL was incorporated in September 1992. 
 
• ACL is headquartered in Bangalore, India. 
 
• ACL is under the administrative control of the Department of Space, which is directly overseen by the Prime Minister of India. 
 
• ACL's services include:
 
 
• Supply of hardware and software 
 
• Remote sensing data service 
 
• Transponder lease service 
 
• Launch services 
 
• Mission support services 
 
• Consultancy and training services 
 
 
 
• Goals: ACL's goals include:
 
 
• Promoting and commercially exploiting space products 
 
• Transferring technologies developed by ISRO 
 
• Facilitating the development of space-related industrial capabilities in India 
 
• Delivering space goods and services to foreign customers worldwide
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Research Corporation Technologies
 
 
• This is a private technology investment and management company based in the United States, focused on the advancement of research and technology, primarily in health sciences.
 
• Founded in 1912, it provides funding for research and early-stage companies developing new technologies.
 
 
 
• Indian National Space Promotion and Authorization Center (IN-SPACe)
 
 
• In India, IN-SPACe was established to allow private companies to participate in space research and development. This initiative is part of India’s broader space reforms to expand private sector involvement alongside ISRO (Indian Space Research Organisation).
 
• Several private players are now participating in space projects, satellite launches, and space technology development under IN-SPACe’s authorization.
 
 
 
• Corporations Related to Aerospace and Space Research
 
 
• In the United States, NASA collaborates with companies like SpaceX and Blue Origin.
 
• In Europe, Arianespace is known for launching satellites for a range of customers around the world.
 
 
 
• Space Corporation Limited and Sky Corporation Limited could imply companies focused on satellite technology, communication networks, or aerospace research.
